blocks.x: Semis and electronics fabrication run the tightest quality-latency loops in industry: yield analytics, tool matching and cleanroom reliability decided by telemetry at nanometer stakes. The fabs that win industrialize root-cause analytics and predictive tool health end to end.

The workflows we industrialize here: Yield analytics/excursion RCA, Defect classification, Predictive tool maintenance, Fab dispatch scheduling, Supply-chain visibility. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Process telemetry, metrology and defect data siloed; excursion root-cause takes days of fab time.
Wafer-defect review by experts; rare classes unlearned.
Vacuums, robots and CMP tools fail unscheduled; tool-down hours compound.
Process recipes are state-grade targets; OT security maturity uneven.
Multi-tier supplier visibility missing; allocation shocks disrupt.
Tool dispatch and lot scheduling combinatorial; incumbent heuristics plateau.
